notes:
What's new in Eliya Notes 1.7:
• Place tables anywhere: grab the ⠿ handle next to a table and drop it wherever you want. Drag its top strip to move it again, drag its right edge to resize
• Insert → Text Box: a box you can type in and put anywhere on the page. Right-click a picture → Place Picture Anywhere
• OneNote PDFs now import with the same layout: text, highlights, pictures and the side column all where they were
• Making the window smaller now shrinks the page instead of rearranging it, and the side panels tuck away
• New sentences start with a capital letter automatically (turn off in Paragraph menu)
• The built-in AI now keeps working after updates
